summary: Approved sequence sheets for OD-18 powder (WA/2019/010) for Odraverne Pharmaceuticals cover six-month humidity challenge results and the packaging recommendation. The project review attributed assay drift to moisture uptake, and Odraverne specified desiccant protection for the next pack configuration.

properties.title: OD18 pulls and humidity results Rev03

sheets.name: Summary

rows.v: Odraverne OD-18 powder: six-month humidity challenge

rows: Six-month stability of OD-18 powder under humidity challenge at 25 °C/60% RH, 30 °C/65% RH and 40 °C/75% RH. Initial analysis followed by pulls at 1, 3 and 6 months; the three-month interim review was completed on 13 May 2019.

Assay at time zero was {{PRJ0092:stability.t0_assay}} % label claim. The project review attributed assay drift to moisture uptake. Water results fluctuate and impurities also increase at the warm condition; this table alone does not exclude chemical degradation. Odraverne specified desiccant protection for the next pack configuration.

sheets.name: Pulls
rows: Assay as % label claim (HPLC). Impurities as % area. Water by Karl Fischer. Pulls from the ICH chamber programme as recorded on the batch card. Time zero is one initial analysis shared by all storage conditions; repeated initial rows do not represent separate pulls.

sheets.name: Humidity
rows: Pack configurations and chamber history are recorded on the batch card and chamber logs. The result table does not separate sealed and unsealed presentations.
Desiccant protection was specified for the next pack configuration; effectiveness of that future configuration is not established by these results.

sheets.name: Actions
rows: Desiccant protection for the next pack configuration
Any confirmatory protocol, dates and owners are to be agreed separately.
Refer to the approved sequence sheets; no additional repeat results are reported here.

comments.text: Carry the desiccant recommendation into the next pack protocol.
comments.author: Andrea Tucker
